title: App signature animation

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Connect compact and full signatures through a visible transition so a small-screen abbreviation remains understandable.
strategic_value: Animating sg into sweetgreen can connect the app’s compact identity with the full brand name.
demonstration: A diagonal phone with a vivid yellow-green screen sits among cut produce; its lettering changes between sg and sweetgreen.
practical_value: Evaluate how the short and long names relate within a loading or introductory screen.

content_islands.name: Phone
content_islands.spec: Center the angled phone and strawberry on the pale ground.

content_islands.name: Signature transition
content_islands.spec: Animate the small green letters on the vivid screen while the surrounding produce remains in place.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip shows the short signature expanding and contracting into the full wordmark.
reference_purposes.Application: The signature transition is presented on a mobile screen.
